name: ideal-agentic-env
description: Production-grade Claude Code environment for enterprise-quality software: constitution, guardrails, compliance, design and stack plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Mandatory foundation: engineering constitution, safety hooks, plan/implement/verify workflow, core subagents.

plugins.name: governance
plugins.description: Mandatory compliance layer: KVKK/GDPR data inventory, threat modeling, audit logging, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence.

plugins.name: work-github
plugins.description: Work intake on GitHub Issues/Projects and local PBI files with one shared schema, through to the pull request.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Per-project design language, design tokens, UI quality rules, accessibility and visual verification.

plugins.name: data-sql
plugins.description: Relational database discipline: safe migrations (SQL and EF Core), indexing, row-level security, query review (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL).

plugins.name: stack-web
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript frontend: React, Next.js, Vue and Nuxt rules, scaffolding, testing, performance budgets.

plugins.name: stack-node
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript backend: Node, NestJS, Fastify rules, scaffolding and testing.

plugins.name: stack-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET / C#: nullable and analyzer discipline, ASP.NET Core patterns, NuGet cooldown, testing with WebApplicationFactory.

plugins.name: stack-java-spring
plugins.description: Java / Spring Boot with Maven or Gradle: Spring Modulith boundaries, ArchUnit, Flyway, Testcontainers, dependency cooldown.

plugins.name: stack-mobile
plugins.description: [experimental] Mobile with React Native and Expo: rendering, accessibility, secure storage, SDK-managed versions, store and privacy rules, device checks on simulators.

plugins.name: devops-selfhosted
plugins.description: Self-hosted DevOps: Dockerfile, Compose and Kubernetes rules (Kubernetes experimental), container scanning, guarded deploy commands, deploy, secrets, observability and backups.
